description: Pins the (q,β)-spectral activation selector (per-partition-k-lambda-rule). FINDING: raw max|μ(ρ_λ(β_D))| picks [3,3], NOT the empirical deuteron dominant [2,2,1,1] — bare eigenvalue magnitude is REFUTED as the selector. The y_λ-weighted Wedderburn contribution |y_λ·χ_λ| (from the canonical chi-deuteron cache) is the correct selector, consistent with tr_M=Σ y_λ χ_λ (the Markov weights set each block's physical weight). Ties the what-activates question to the same y_λ tower as the block-swap symmetrizer.

data.finding: NEITHER raw max-|μ| ([3,3]) NOR raw |y_λ·χ_λ| ([6]) reproduces the framework empirical deuteron dominant [2,2,1,1] (which has tiny raw contribution ~2e-4). The activation selector is the Φ_q-truncated dilogarithm TOWER |y_λ Σ_a Φ_q^{≤k}(μ_a)| (per-partition-k-lambda-rule.md), a more refined observable than either bare eigenvalue max or raw trace contribution — requires the framework's Φ_q machinery.
